inventoryFertilizers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Create ONE production-style transparent square Gredice farming-game operation icon. Use the provided backpack and carrot award as style references only. Tactile matte materials, broad visible bevels and low-poly facets, rich forest and leaf greens, earthy tones and honey/amber accents, warm top-left light with deep shaded right sides. Show a compact centered elevated three-quarter arrangement with large distinct objects readable at 48px and 7% clear margin. Inventory clipboard is a small physical object, with symbolic checks only. True transparent space around the objects. No figures, background, floor, exterior shadow, frame, floating effects, letters, numbers or legible writing.
Operation: Inventura sredstava za gnojidbu.
Subject: Two chunky squat olive and amber garden nutrient bottles and one tan paper sack with a simple physical sprout emblem, plus a small scoop of bold little beige fertilizer pellets. A small green inventory clipboard with raised checkmarks is secondary, leaning against the group. This is a nutrient stock arrangement with broad round containers, no trigger sprays or insects.
inventoryFertilizers.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
